newsitem.title: USA: IWC says suspends stock purchase program.
newsitem.headline: IWC says suspends stock purchase program.

text.p: IWC Resources Corp said as of October 1 it will temporarily suspend sales of its stock under an option cash purchase feature of its dividend reinvestment and share purchase plan.
The utility holding company said it has raised $22 million since March 1995 under the plan, "an amount vastly exceeding original expectations."

"The plan has been unexpectedly popular and ran out of shares in December 1995. IWC Resources registered another one million shares in January 1996, of which approximately 360,000 remain available to issue," the company said.
IWC added it plans to register more shares and reexamine renewal of the optional cash purchase feature in 1997.
